server.listen_addr.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

server.port.description: UDP port to listen on. Port 53 is standard for DNS traffic.

server.domain.description: The DNS domain you own and will use for tunneling (e.g., 'iodine.example.com'). Must resolve to this server’s IP.

auth.password.description: Shared secret used by clients to authenticate. Must match on all connecting clients.

limits.max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent client sessions allowed.

limits.timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before an idle session is dropped.

limits.mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) in bytes for tunnel packets. Typically 1140–1280 to avoid IP fragmentation.

logging.debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

logging.log_stdout.description: Whether to output logs to standard output (console). Ignored if log_file is non-empty.

logging.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to empty string ('') to disable file logging.

features.tos.description: Type of Service (ToS) byte (0–255) to set on outgoing IP packets. 0 = default service.

features.ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for the server (requires system and kernel support).

features.zlib.description: Enable zlib compression for payload data. Improves throughput over slow links.

users.description: List of authorized users with fixed IP addresses. Each user must provide the matching password and username during connection.

name.description: Username for authentication and log identification.

ip.description: IPv4 address to assign to this user in the tunnel (e.g., '10.0.0.2'). Must be within the domain’s allocated subnet.
